ideas.title: The 1-Second Test to Expose Fake AI Callers
ideas.angle: Teaches viewers the instant audio interruption trick that forces real-time AI voice clones to stutter and drop due to processing latency. Features a built-in comment trigger asking viewers to post the safest family code word they use.

hook.en: Say this word to spot fake callers.

ideas.reason: AI voice scams have surged massively according to FTC alerts, making real-time tech defense tricks extremely viral for high-retention short-form video audiences.
sources: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Consumer Sentinel Network Report
MIT Media Lab Synthetic Media Audio Analysis

ideas.title: The Creepy AI Tracking Your Keyboard Rhythm
ideas.angle: Reveals how modern websites use AI behavioral biometrics to identify you by your unique typing cadence even when using VPNs or incognito mode. Ends with a 3-second live typing test command driving comment spam.

hook.en: Websites are silently tracking how you type.

ideas.reason: Behavioral biometrics is an explosive topic in privacy tech; revealing that incognito mode doesn't stop typing profiling creates instant viewer paranoia and massive shares.
sources: IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security
Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) Research

ideas.title: The Hidden Motion Sensor Tracking Your Every Step
ideas.angle: Exposes how apps use unprompted accelerometer data to calculate physical environment and movement without needing GPS permissions. Prompts viewers to toggle off browser motion permissions live on screen to max out watch time.

hook.en: Turn off this hidden phone sensor now.

ideas.reason: Mobile privacy audits revealing back-door sensor tracking generate peak curiosity and high Viewed-vs-Swiped-Away rates due to actionable phone security commands.
sources: ACM Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems
